static_findings: Auditor imports only stdlib and independently duplicates fixed protocol/model/optimizer/schedule constants. It does not import producer/experiment code, Torch or Transformers.
Root protocol, both producer-source and thirteen frozen dependency pins are present and were independently checked against actual current file bytes by AST literal extraction and SHA256.

Identity checks connect nonce/role/PID/creation, ancestry, frozen actual/launcher/native image metadata, raw samples, brackets, inventories, live checks and cleanup retained exit identities. Self-reported launcher hash is kept distinct from retained-handle actual image evidence.

Two dense updates require exact integer step and target counts, two finite loss diagnostics, finite final validity, seventy-six exact integer AdamW counters, changed valid parameter hash, fixed optimizer, timing/throughput recomputation and no checkpoint/holdout claims.

Raw parent samples have ordered identity/CPU clocks and one corresponding memory-query cost interval each. Stage bracket parents must exist in raw samples; memory brackets and allocation/cap deltas are independently recomputed.

Held off/on windows require complete query/sample index slices in their clocks, enabled sample/query kind counts and zero disabled-window work; raw CPU deltas are recomputed. Busy gaps/CPU progress, sampled crossing, termination/cap latency and cleanup are cross-checked.
Failed top-level/case reports and retained error/cleanup fields fail audit. Audit never overwrites or upgrades the producer report; only a separate new output path is written by CLI.

JSON reader rejects duplicate keys and nonfinite constants, with frozen pre-execution report16MiB and protocol/implementation1MiB limits. Optional executable/model file checks remain explicitly listed as unperformed unless paths are supplied.
